prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1243; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical whiplash injury. The mechanism of the collision is in keeping with the type and degree of force that would be expected to produce this injury. Over the course of 22 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, manual therapy, and a home exercise program, and followed a typical recovery pathway with symptoms gradually decreasing and visit frequency tapering as function improved. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly corroborate the diagnosis, including reduced range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness. No prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine is known to this office. Billing records reflect the services rendered on an appropriate schedule, with no duplicate or repeated charges for the same service. Patient is currently improving and is expected to reach maximum medical improvement with continued home exercise.
